# FG-GIT-0028

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `every_path_rule_has_its_reason` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: このファイルのパスには保存できません。パスを確認してください（`..`、`.git`、先頭の `/` は使えません）。
- en: The file cannot be saved at this path. Check the path (`..`, `.git` and a leading `/` are not allowed).
- id: File tidak dapat disimpan di path ini. Periksa path-nya (`..`, `.git`, dan `/` di awal tidak diizinkan).

## 原因 (cause)

The `path` of a single-file commit (the simple editor) is not a path the editor may write. Rules of the text (`rule`): `empty`, `absolute` (starts with `/`), `backslash` (a `\`: never a separator in git), `empty_segment` (`//` or a trailing `/`), `dot_segment` (`.` or `..`), `dot_git` (a segment a developer's file system reads as `.git`: any case, trailing dots and spaces, a `:` stream suffix such as `::$INDEX_ALLOCATION`, zero-width / default-ignorable code points, and git's 8.3 short name `git~<n>`; git's own directory), `control` (a control character, NUL included), `too_long` (more than 4096 bytes). Rules of the tree at the branch's head (`rule`): `path_is_directory` (a directory is there), `parent_is_file` (a parent segment is a file), `not_regular_file` (a symbolic link or a submodule is there: the editor writes regular files only), `refused_by_git` (git's `update-index`, run with `core.protectNTFS` and `core.protectHFS`, refused the entry, or skipped it with exit 0 (`Ignoring path`): the written tree is read back and must hold exactly the entry). A segment that is empty on disk (`...`, `. .`) is `dot_segment`. Nothing was written.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The log event carries `rule`, `project_id`, `repo_id`, `route=single_file_commit` (never the path itself). Read the tree at the branch's head (read-only): `git -C <repo> ls-tree <branch> -- <dir>`.

## 対処 (fix)

Choose a relative path of a regular file, for example `docs/spec.md`.
